items.exampleEn: Some small birds drink nectar all day.
items.exampleZh: 有些小鳥整天都在喝花蜜。

items.exampleEn: We eat lunch in the school canteen.
items.exampleZh: 我們在學校餐廳吃午餐。

items.exampleEn: This cheap bread is dry and tasteless.
items.exampleZh: 這種便宜麵包又乾又沒味道。
items.glossZh: 沒有味道的；淡而無味的

items.exampleEn: The barman poured two glasses of orange juice.
Chewing gum is not allowed in class.
Courgettes are easy to grow in summer.
My frying pan is too small for a big family.
items.exampleZh: 我的平底鍋對大家庭來說太小了。

items.sentenceEn: The factory canteen serves hot meals at noon.
items.sentenceZh: 工廠的員工餐廳中午供應熱騰騰的餐點。

items.audioEn: Don't put the frying pan in the dishwasher. Wash it by hand with warm water.
items.audioZh: 不要把平底鍋放進洗碗機，用溫水手洗。

items.sentenceEn: Bees collect nectar to make honey.
items.sentenceZh: 蜜蜂採集花蜜來製造蜂蜜。

items.sentenceEn: The barman asked for my order.

items.stemEn: Cook the eggs in a ____ with a little butter.
items.stemZh: 用一點奶油在平底鍋裡煎蛋。

items.stemEn: Without any salt, the soup was ____.

items.passageEn: Kai works in the staff canteen of a large company. Every morning, he cuts courgettes and heats oil in a huge frying pan. Some workers say the food is tasteless, so Kai now adds more spices. In the afternoon, he works like a barman and sells drinks. His favorite is a sweet drink made with flower nectar and lemon. His workplace is noisy, but he loves it.
items.passageZh: Kai 在一家大公司的員工餐廳工作。每天早上，他切櫛瓜，在一個巨大的平底鍋裡熱油。有些員工說菜沒味道，所以 Kai 現在會多加一些香料。下午，他像酒保一樣賣飲料。他最喜歡的是一種用花蜜和檸檬做的甜飲料。他的工作場所很吵，但他很喜歡。

questions.questionZh: 有些員工對餐點有什麼意見？

referenceEn: My mother often makes soup with courgettes.
My mom often cooks courgette soup.
rubricZh: courgette 表示「櫛瓜」，可數名詞
「用……煮湯」可寫，例如 make／cook soup with…、cook courgette soup 等
時態配合內容（多用現在簡單式）

items.promptZh: 他的鞋底黏到了一塊口香糖。
referenceEn: A piece of chewing gum got stuck on his shoe.
He got a piece of chewing gum stuck on the bottom of his shoe.
rubricZh: 用 chewing gum 表示「口香糖」（例如 a piece of chewing gum）
「黏到」可寫，例如 got stuck on…、stuck to… 等
